data.narrative:
Fire Point is a Series A defense and security technology company founded by Denys Shtilerman, Iryna Terekh, and Yehor Skalyha, with backing from the Ukrainian Ministry of Defence. Valuation analysis relies on a peer-median approach across ten same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, spanning both public equities (2 names including DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS) and private venture-backed firms (8 names including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI).

The peer-median method yielded $1.0B, reflecting the median valuation across the ten-company set. The comparable universe spans a wide range: $125M floor to $3.0B ceiling. Named peers in the sample include Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B (Series B). This distribution anchors the median at the $1.0B midpoint.

Given the single-method triangulation available, the analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with $1.0B as the median point estimate. Key uncertainties include Fire Point's relative market position, revenue traction, and defensibility versus the broader peer set, particularly given the nascent stage and geopolitical context of its backing. The width of the peer range ($125M–$3.0B) itself signals high variability in comparable valuations within this sector at this stage.
